import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_path (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  match p with
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      (∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: rest)

-- Shortest path predicate
def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

-- Negative cycle predicate
def WeightedGraph.has_negative_cycle (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p w, g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast? ∧ g.path_has_weight p w ∧ w < 0

def WeightedGraph.weights_and_size_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bellman_ford_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  start < graph.size ∧
  graph.weights_and_size_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- `Option Int` with `none` read as `+∞`. -/
def optAdd : Option Int → Int → Option Int
  | none, _ => none
  | some a, w => some (a + w)

def optMin : Option Int → Option Int → Option Int
  | none, b => b
  | some a, none => some a
  | some a, some b => some (min a b)

/-- `a ≤ b` where `none = +∞`. -/
def optLe : Option Int → Option Int → Prop
  | _, none => True
  | none, some _ => False
  | some a, some b => a ≤ b

/-- Minimum of a list of extended values (`none = +∞`, empty list = `+∞`). -/
def optMinList : List (Option Int) → Option Int
  | [] => none
  | a :: l => optMin a (optMinList l)

/-- Weight of the (unique, since the graph is simple) edge `u → v`. -/
def WeightedGraph.edgeW (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) : Option Int :=
  ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun p => p.1 == v)).map Prod.snd

/-- Candidates for the new value of vertex `v`: its current value together with
`d[u] + w(u,v)` for every incoming edge. -/
def bfCands (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) : List (Option Int) :=
  (d.getD v none) ::
    (List.range g.size).filterMap
      (fun u => (g.edgeW u v).map (fun w => optAdd (d.getD u none) w))

/-- One relaxation of vertex `v`. -/
def bfRelax (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) : Option Int :=
  optMinList (bfCands g d v)

/-- One full round of relaxation over all edges. -/
def bfStep (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) : List (Option Int) :=
  (List.range g.size).map (bfRelax g d)

/-- Distance table after `k` rounds. -/
def bfTable (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Nat → List (Option Int)
  | 0 => (List.range g.size).map (fun v => if v = start then some 0 else none)
  | k + 1 => bfStep g (bfTable g start k)

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def bellman_ford (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : bellman_ford_precond graph start) : Option (List (Option Int)) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let d := bfTable graph start (graph.size - 1)
  if bfStep graph d = d then some d else none
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bellman_ford_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (result : Option (List (Option Int)))
    (_ : bellman_ford_precond graph start) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some dists =>
      dists.length = graph.size ∧
      ∀ v, v < graph.size →
        match dists.getD v none with
        | some d => graph.is_shortest_dist start v d
        | none => ¬ ∃ p, graph.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v
  | none =>
      graph.has_negative_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

theorem getD_range_map (n v : Nat) (f : Nat → Option Int) (h : v < n) :
    ((List.range n).map f).getD v none = f v := by
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  simp [List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_range, h]

theorem bfStep_length (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) :
    (bfStep g d).length = g.size := by
  simp [bfStep]

theorem bfTable_length (g : WeightedGraph) (start k : Nat) :
    (bfTable g start k).length = g.size := by
  cases k with
  | zero => simp [bfTable]
  | succ k => simp [bfTable, bfStep]

/-! ### `optLe` / `optMin` / `optAdd` toolkit -/

theorem optLe_refl (a : Option Int) : optLe a a := by
  cases a <;> simp [optLe]

theorem optLe_trans {a b c : Option Int} (h1 : optLe a b) (h2 : optLe b c) : optLe a c := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> simp only [optLe] at * <;> first | trivial | omega

theorem optMin_le_left (a b : Option Int) : optLe (optMin a b) a := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp only [optMin, optLe] <;> first | trivial | omega

theorem optMin_le_right (a b : Option Int) : optLe (optMin a b) b := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp only [optMin, optLe] <;> first | trivial | omega

theorem optAdd_mono {a b : Option Int} (w : Int) (h : optLe a b) :
    optLe (optAdd a w) (optAdd b w) := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp only [optLe, optAdd] at * <;> first | trivial | omega

theorem optMinList_le_of_mem {l : List (Option Int)} {x : Option Int} (h : x ∈ l) :
    optLe (optMinList l) x := by
  induction l with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons a l ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
    · exact optMin_le_left _ _
    · exact optLe_trans (optMin_le_right _ _) (ih h)

theorem optMinList_mem : ∀ (l : List (Option Int)) (a : Int),
    optMinList l = some a → some a ∈ l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a h; exact absurd h (by simp [optMinList])
  | cons b l ih =>
    intro a h
    cases b with
    | none =>
      have h' : optMinList l = some a := h
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih a h')
    | some b =>
      have h' : optMin (some b) (optMinList l) = some a := h
      cases hr : optMinList l with
      | none =>
        rw [hr] at h'
        simp only [optMin, Option.some.injEq] at h'
        subst h'; simp
      | some c =>
        rw [hr] at h'
        simp only [optMin, Option.some.injEq] at h'
        rcases min_choice b c with hm | hm
        · rw [hm] at h'; subst h'; simp
        · rw [hm] at h'; subst h'; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih _ hr)

/-! ### `edgeW` -/

theorem adj_getD_of_ge (g : WeightedGraph) (u : Nat) (h : ¬ u < g.size) :
    g.adj.getD u #[] = #[] := by
  have h' : ¬ u < g.adj.size := h
  simp [Array.getD, h']

theorem edgeW_sound {g : WeightedGraph} {u v : Nat} {w : Int} (h : g.edgeW u v = some w) :
    g.has_edge u v w := by
  unfold WeightedGraph.edgeW at h
  cases hf : ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun p => p.1 == v)) with
  | none => rw [hf] at h; simp at h
  | some p =>
    rw [hf] at h
    simp only [Option.map_some', Option.some.injEq] at h
    have hmem : p ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf
    have hpv : p.1 = v := by
      have := List.find?_some hf
      simpa using this
    have hu : u < g.size := by
      by_contra hc
      rw [adj_getD_of_ge g u hc] at hmem
      simp at hmem
    exact ⟨hu, p, by simpa using hmem, hpv, h⟩

theorem edgeW_complete {g : WeightedGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u v : Nat} {w : Int}
    (h : g.has_edge u v w) : g.edgeW u v = some w := by
  obtain ⟨hu, pair, hmem, hpv, hpw⟩ := h
  have hmem' : pair ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := by simpa using hmem
  unfold WeightedGraph.edgeW
  cases hf : ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.find? (fun p => p.1 == v)) with
  | none =>
    exfalso
    have := List.find?_eq_none.1 hf pair hmem'
    simp [hpv] at this
  | some q =>
    have hqmem : q ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf
    have hqv : q.1 = v := by
      have := List.find?_some hf
      simpa using this
    have := (hwf u hu).2 q pair (by simpa using hqmem) (by simpa using hmem') (by rw [hqv, hpv])
    subst this
    simp [hpw]

/-! ### Path lemmas -/

theorem phw_imp_is_path (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (w : Int), p ≠ [] → g.path_has_weight p w → g.is_path p := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro w h _; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons x q ih =>
    intro w _ hw
    cases q with
    | nil => exact ⟨by simp, trivial⟩
    | cons y q =>
      obtain ⟨e, wr, he, hr, -⟩ := hw
      exact ⟨by simp, ⟨e, he⟩, ih wr (by simp) hr⟩

theorem is_path_weight (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ p : List Nat, g.is_path p → ∃ w, g.path_has_weight p w := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd h.1 (by simp)
  | cons x q ih =>
    intro h
    cases q with
    | nil => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    | cons y q =>
      obtain ⟨-, ⟨e, he⟩, hp⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨wr, hwr⟩ := ih hp
      exact ⟨e + wr, e, wr, he, hwr, rfl⟩

theorem phw_snoc_iff (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (q : List Nat) (x v : Nat) (w : Int),
    g.path_has_weight (x :: (q ++ [v])) w ↔
      ∃ u w' e, (x :: q).getLast? = some u ∧ g.path_has_weight (x :: q) w' ∧
        g.has_edge u v e ∧ w = w' + e := by
  intro q
  induction q with
  | nil =>
    intro x v w
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨e, wr, he, hr, rfl⟩
      have hwr : wr = 0 := hr
      exact ⟨x, 0, e, by simp, rfl, he, by omega⟩
    · rintro ⟨u, w', e, hu, hw', he, rfl⟩
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at hu
      subst hu
      have : w' = 0 := hw'
      subst this
      exact ⟨e, 0, he, rfl, by omega⟩
  | cons a q ih =>
    intro x v w
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨e, wr, he, hr, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨u, w', e2, hu, hw', he2, rfl⟩ := (ih a v wr).1 hr
      refine ⟨u, e + w', e2, ?_, ⟨e, w', he, hw', rfl⟩, he2, by omega⟩
      first
      | simpa using hu
      | (rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons]; exact hu)
    · rintro ⟨u, w', e2, hu, hw', he2, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨e, wr, he, hr, rfl⟩ := hw'
      refine ⟨e, wr + e2, he, ?_, by omega⟩
      refine (ih a v (wr + e2)).2 ⟨u, wr, e2, ?_, hr, he2, rfl⟩
      first
      | simpa using hu
      | (rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at hu; exact hu)

theorem cons_snoc_of_getLast (p : List Nat) (v : Nat) (h2 : 2 ≤ p.length)
    (hl : p.getLast? = some v) :
    ∃ x0 q, p = x0 :: (q ++ [v]) ∧ p.length = q.length + 2 := by
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at h2
  | cons x t =>
    have ht : t ≠ [] := by
      intro hc; subst hc; simp at h2
    have hlt : t.getLast? = some v := by
      cases t with
      | nil => exact absurd rfl ht
      | cons y s =>
        first
        | simpa using hl
        | (rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at hl; exact hl)
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, t = q ++ [v] := by
      first
      | exact (List.getLast?_eq_some_iff).1 hlt
      | exact ⟨t.dropLast, by
          have := List.dropLast_append_getLast ht
          rw [List.getLast?_eq_getLast _ ht] at hlt
          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hlt
          rw [← hlt]; exact this.symm⟩
    refine ⟨x, q, by rw [hq], ?_⟩
    rw [hq]; simp

/-! ### `bfCands` / `bfRelax` -/

theorem bfCands_mem_self (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) :
    d.getD v none ∈ bfCands g d v := by simp [bfCands]

theorem bfCands_mem_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v u : Nat)
    (hu : u < g.size) (e : Int) (h : g.edgeW u v = some e) :
    optAdd (d.getD u none) e ∈ bfCands g d v := by
  simp only [bfCands, List.mem_cons]
  right
  refine List.mem_filterMap.2 ⟨u, List.mem_range.2 hu, ?_⟩
  rw [h]; rfl

theorem bfRelax_le_self (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) :
    optLe (bfRelax g d v) (d.getD v none) :=
  optMinList_le_of_mem (bfCands_mem_self g d v)

theorem bfRelax_le_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v u : Nat)
    (hu : u < g.size) (e : Int) (h : g.edgeW u v = some e) :
    optLe (bfRelax g d v) (optAdd (d.getD u none) e) :=
  optMinList_le_of_mem (bfCands_mem_edge g d v u hu e h)

theorem bfRelax_mem (g : WeightedGraph) (d : List (Option Int)) (v : Nat) (x : Int)
    (h : bfRelax g d v = some x) :
    d.getD v none = some x ∨
      ∃ u e, u < g.size ∧ g.edgeW u v = some e ∧ optAdd (d.getD u none) e = some x := by
  have hm := optMinList_mem _ x h
  simp only [bfCands, List.mem_cons, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range] at hm
  rcases hm with h1 | ⟨u, hu, hf⟩
  · exact Or.inl h1.symm
  · right
    cases he : g.edgeW u v with
    | none => rw [he] at hf; simp at hf
    | some e =>
      rw [he] at hf
      simp only [Option.map_some', Option.some.injEq] at hf
      exact ⟨u, e, hu, he, hf⟩

/-! ### Soundness: every finite table entry is realized by a walk -/

theorem bfTable_sound (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) :
    ∀ (k v : Nat) (x : Int), v < g.size →
      (bfTable g start k).getD v none = some x →
      ∃ p, p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧
           g.path_has_weight p x ∧ p.length ≤ k + 1 := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v x hv h
    rw [bfTable, getD_range_map _ _ _ hv] at h
    by_cases hvs : v = start
    · subst hvs
      rw [if_pos rfl] at h
      have hx : x = 0 := by simpa using h.symm
      subst hx
      exact ⟨[v], by simp, by simp, rfl, by simp⟩
    · rw [if_neg hvs] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v x hv h
    rw [bfTable, bfStep, getD_range_map _ _ _ hv] at h
    rcases bfRelax_mem g _ v x h with h1 | ⟨u, e, hu, hew, hadd⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, hh, hl, hw, hlen⟩ := ih v x hv h1
      exact ⟨p, hh, hl, hw, by omega⟩
    · cases hdu : (bfTable g start k).getD u none with
      | none => rw [hdu] at hadd; simp [optAdd] at hadd
      | some y =>
        rw [hdu] at hadd
        simp only [optAdd, Option.some.injEq] at hadd
        obtain ⟨p, hh, hl, hw, hlen⟩ := ih u y hu hdu
        obtain ⟨x0, q, rfl⟩ : ∃ x0 q, p = x0 :: q := by
          cases p with
          | nil => simp at hh
          | cons a t => exact ⟨a, t, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨x0 :: (q ++ [v]), by simpa using hh, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [show x0 :: (q ++ [v]) = (x0 :: q) ++ [v] from rfl]
          exact List.getLast?_concat
        · have hstep := (phw_snoc_iff g q x0 v (y + e)).2
            ⟨u, y, e, hl, hw, edgeW_sound hew, rfl⟩
          rw [hadd] at hstep
          exact hstep
        · simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hlen ⊢
          omega

/-! ### Optimality: the table under-approximates every short walk -/

theorem bfTable_opt (g : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hs : start < g.size) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (p : List Nat) (w : Int) (v : Nat), v < g.size →
      p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some v → g.path_has_weight p w →
      p.length ≤ k + 1 → optLe ((bfTable g start k).getD v none) (some w) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro p w v hv hh hl hpw hlen
    match p, hh with
    | x :: t, hh =>
      have ht : t = [] := by
        cases t with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons y s => simp at hlen
      subst ht
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hh
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at hl
      subst hh; subst hl
      have hw0 : w = 0 := hpw
      subst hw0
      rw [bfTable, getD_range_map _ _ _ hv, if_pos rfl]
      simp [optLe]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro p w v hv hh hl hpw hlen
    by_cases hshort : p.length ≤ k + 1
    · refine optLe_trans ?_ (ih p w v hv hh hl hpw hshort)
      rw [bfTable, bfStep, getD_range_map _ _ _ hv]
      exact bfRelax_le_self g _ v
    · have h2 : 2 ≤ p.length := by omega
      obtain ⟨x0, q, rfl, hlen2⟩ := cons_snoc_of_getLast p v h2 hl
      obtain ⟨u, w', e, hu, hw', he, rfl⟩ := (phw_snoc_iff g q x0 v w).1 hpw
      have hun : u < g.size := by
        obtain ⟨hus, pair, hmem, hpv, -⟩ := he
        have := (hwf u hus).1 pair hmem
        omega
      have hhq : (x0 :: q).head? = some start := by simpa using hh
      have hlq : (x0 :: q).length ≤ k + 1 := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at *
        omega
      have hIH := ih (x0 :: q) w' u hun hhq hu hw' hlq
      rw [bfTable, bfStep, getD_range_map _ _ _ hv]
      refine optLe_trans (bfRelax_le_edge g _ v u hun e (edgeW_complete hwf he)) ?_
      have := optAdd_mono (a := (bfTable g start k).getD u none) (b := some w') e hIH
      simpa [optAdd] using this

/-! ### Stability at a fixed point -/

theorem bfTable_fix (g : WeightedGraph) (start n : Nat)
    (hfix : bfStep g (bfTable g start n) = bfTable g start n) :
    ∀ m, n ≤ m → bfTable g start m = bfTable g start n := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => intro h; have : n = 0 := by omega
            rw [this]
  | succ m ih =>
    intro h
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n (m + 1) with hlt | hge
    · have hm : n ≤ m := by omega
      rw [bfTable, ih hm, hfix]
    · have : n = m + 1 := by omega
      rw [this]

/-! ### List plumbing -/

theorem optLe_antisymm : ∀ {a b : Option Int}, optLe a b → optLe b a → a = b := by
  intro a b h1 h2
  cases a with
  | none =>
    cases b with
    | none => rfl
    | some b => exact absurd h1 (by simp [optLe])
  | some a =>
    cases b with
    | none => exact absurd h2 (by simp [optLe])
    | some b =>
      simp only [optLe] at h1 h2
      exact congrArg some (le_antisymm h1 h2)

theorem list_eq_of_getD (l1 l2 : List (Option Int)) (h : l1.length = l2.length)
    (hg : ∀ i, i < l1.length → l1.getD i none = l2.getD i none) : l1 = l2 := by
  apply List.ext_getElem h
  intro i h1 h2
  have hgi := hg i h1
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
    List.getElem?_eq_getElem h1, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h2] at hgi
  simpa using hgi

theorem getLast?_append_cons : ∀ (a : List Nat) (x : Nat) (c : List Nat),
    (a ++ x :: c).getLast? = (x :: c).getLast? := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | nil => intro x c; rfl
  | cons y a ih =>
    intro x c
    cases ha : a ++ x :: c with
    | nil => exact absurd ha (by simp)
    | cons z t =>
      rw [List.cons_append, ha, List.getLast?_cons_cons, ← ha]
      exact ih x c

theorem exists_dup (l : List Nat) (h : ¬ l.Nodup) :
    ∃ (x : Nat) (a b c : List Nat), l = a ++ x :: b ++ x :: c := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact absurd List.nodup_nil h
  | cons y t ih =>
    by_cases hy : y ∈ t
